issues.summary: Spec step 6 'config-test additions' — clef schema/merge/validate coverage lived only in cnb-clef-tests.js, cnb-config-tests.js untouched
issues.resolution: Moved the 12 clef section tests (schema defaults, merge, and validation cases) into cnb-tests/cnb-config-tests.js where Module A behavior belongs; cnb-clef-tests.js keeps rendering/import/invariance coverage and points to the move in its header.

issues.summary: Clef validation not type-safe: truthy non-object clef.glyphs, null/primitive glyph defs, or malformed clef sections could make validate() throw
issues.resolution: validate() clef block now guards every access with an isPlainObject check: non-object clef sections are treated as absent; non-object clef.glyphs reports 'clef.glyphs must be an object map of clef definitions'; non-string active reports the no-glyph error; null/primitive definitions report 'Clef glyph "<name>" is not an object'. validate() always returns a result object. 4 new tests cover wrong-typed glyphs (42/"map"/array), null/primitive defs, malformed sections (7/"on"/[true]/null), and non-string active.

issues.summary: clef.gutter.paddingH used for layout math but never validated
issues.resolution: When clef.enabled, a present clef.gutter must be a plain object and a present paddingH must be a finite non-negative number (error otherwise); absent gutter/paddingH stays valid (renderer defaults to 12). 1 new test covers -4/NaN/"12"/Infinity (errors), 0 and absent (valid), and a non-object gutter.

falsePositivesPerVerifier: per-definition float top-edge anchor (explicitly endorsed, operator-instructed investigation)
dedicated clef.glyphs map (explicitly endorsed, spec-offered choice, documented)
Date-line normalization in the export baseline test (explicitly endorsed)
